image.name: openshot
image.description: [OpenShot](https://openshot.org/) Video Editor is an award-winning free and open-source video editor for Linux, Mac, and Windows, and is dedicated to delivering high quality video editing and animation solutions to the world.

changelog.desc: Rebase to Ubuntu Resolute, install from ppa.
Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to selkies. Breaking Change: HTTPS is now required. Either use a reverse proxy (like SWAG) with SSL cert or direct connect to port 3001 with HTTPS.

volumes.desc: User's home directory in the container, stores program settings and files.

ports.desc: OpenShot desktop gui (for reverse proxy only).

image.title: Openshot
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  openshot:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/openshot:latest
    container_name: openshot
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/openshot/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=openshot \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/openshot/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/openshot:latest
